title: ULIQ Testnet Hub
subtitle: Presale, vesting, utility locking, and entitlements in one traceable testnet flow.
legalNotice: Testnet / provisional. ADR-001 remains blocked; this is not a live offering or Mainnet approval.
unavailable: ULIQ is not enabled in this environment.
walletMismatch: Connect the server-linked wallet {wallet} on Arbitrum Sepolia.

sale.title: Presale status
sale.description: Finalized block data, hard-cap progress, and the current maximum purchase.

purchase.title: Prepare testnet purchase
purchase.description: Enter a USDC amount, review the contract quote, then confirm approval and purchase in your wallet.
purchase.partial: Partial fill: the contract accepts only the remaining available amount.
purchase.inactive: Purchases are available only while the sale is ACTIVE. Current state: {state}.
purchase.pending: After purchase, the allocation remains fully inactive until the withdrawal period has ended. tUSDC remains in escrow until withdrawal or finalization and is released to the treasury when finalized.

entitlement.title: Entitlement
entitlement.description: Wallet + unreleased vesting + locked, block-consistent and excluding pending presale allocations.

vesting.title: Presale vesting
vesting.description: 75% of each finalized allocation vests linearly from the global DEX launch timestamp.
vesting.waiting: Waiting for the global DEX launch timestamp. No vesting release is available yet.

locking.title: Utility locking
locking.description: Pure utility locking for 30, 90, or 180 days — without APY, rewards, or distributions.

purchases.title: Presale purchases
purchases.empty: No indexed purchases for this wallet yet.
purchases.finalizeSyncingHint: Finalization was submitted. The wallet transaction and indexer status are being reconciled; no further confirmation is required.
purchases.pendingInactive: Pending allocation: 0 ULIQ available and 0 benefits active until finalization.

messages.txSubmitted: Transaction submitted. Waiting for one confirmation …
messages.txConfirmed: Wallet transaction confirmed. The indexer will refresh the status shortly.
messages.txReverted: The wallet transaction reverted and was not executed.
messages.approvalConfirmed: Approval confirmed. Please sign the main transaction now.
messages.walletRequired: A matching linked wallet is required.
messages.actionFailed: The action could not be completed.

billing.hint: Checkout validates the linked wallet and creates an exact 10-minute reservation. ULIQ is never used as payment.
billing.unavailable: The ULIQ discount cannot be reserved right now. The checkout was not created.

admin.title: ULIQ Operations
admin.subtitle: Indexer, reconciliation, price quality, reservations, and Safe-compatible preparation — without server signing.
admin.testnetNotice: Testnet operations only. ADR-001 is blocked and no server-side signing or broadcast is available.
admin.tiersDescription: Versioned thresholds and discounts. The testnet migration defaults all monetary discounts to zero.
admin.treasuryDescription: Store the desired receiving wallet, verify onchain state, and prepare Safe-compatible transactions for a controlled rotation.
admin.treasuryTwoStep: Rotation is two-step: the contract owner proposes the new treasury, then that exact treasury must accept the role itself. The API never signs or submits transactions.
admin.treasuryDesiredHint: Mainnet requires a dedicated multisig/Safe wallet; never a personal EOA.
admin.treasurySaved: Desired treasury address saved and reconciled with finalized onchain state.
admin.safeDescription: The API checks DEX_PENDING and pendingPurchaseCount = 0. It does not sign or submit anything.
admin.prepared: Safe-compatible payload prepared and audited. Nothing was signed or submitted.
admin.fourEyes: The external Safe must be verified with a signer threshold of at least 2 before this payload is approved.
admin.noPayload: No payload has been prepared yet.
